notes: Compliance beta 2: the emergency kit (the office enters its contents; each drug and supply has its own expiry, amber 60 days out and red at 30; the monthly kit check; Replace keeps history and Used shows Restock needed), drills (medical every 6 months and fire every year, each fix becomes a task, everyone who took part gets it on their own record), and SOP owners on the Library's SOP pages (an owner, a review cycle and required roles; the review is a check for the owner). Checks never done get 30 days before they go overdue, and a manager can enter when a check was last done before Diastema tracked it. Migration 26. Needs edge 0.21.0, like beta 1.
